I don't like spiders, but I do catch and release them if they are in my house. The only spiders I kill are deadly venomous ones. Redbacks etc. Even then, that is only to protect myself and my animals.

We have a relative of the redback in North America called the black widow. They only have the red hourglass underneath. This year I found one of the devils living in my mailbox, and another near it. Naturally I killed them.

We also have the brown recluse spider, whose bite kills skin and leaves a rotting area. I found one of them in my water glass in the bathroom once. They are everywhere but rarely bite humans.

Fortunately those are the only two of our spiders that are really dangerous. So I leave the rest alone. Especially the cellar spiders - they are said to eat other spiders.

I wouldn't like to tangle with a brown recluse that's for sure. I found a huntsman that was as big, if not bigger than my hand the other morning, I just left him alone. I'm in the south so I don't have to deal with Funnel webs thank god. The nastiest here in Victoria are Redbacks, White tails, and Wolf spiders. There is a Victorian Funnel web, just not quite as nasty as its Sydney counterparts. Snakes are probably more of a worry though.

Black widows haven't killed anyone in the US in decades now. Brown Recluses are so much more dangerous. Buddy I had growing up was bitten on his cheek. His skin rotted til he had a hole all the way through to his mouth. He had to have the dead tissue removed, it becomes necrotic, and plastic surgery to fix the hole.

I told my father we had them in our house. He didn't believe me. After my buddy got bit he finally called a guy out. We had a plan where we could call an exterminator out whenever and they would come spray each year. A house was built behind our neighborhood in the woods, and we think that is where they came from. Sure enough, within 5 minutes of an in-house inspection he found 2 nests. One in a place my dad even said he looked. I have severe arachnophobia. My dad didn't take any chances and had the house fumigated. We stayed in a hotel for a couple of days. I could have easily ended up like my buddy.

So rule of thumb for me is if there is new development near where I live, I just go ahead and make an appointment. Father-in-law does that after a new house was built in their neighborhood. I told him he should have a guy come out. Didn't listen. Next thing they have a bug problem.
